name: ResizeColumnsRowsInExcelWorksheetNode
label: Resize Columns/Rows in Excel Worksheet
description: Resizes (auto-fits or sets specific dimensions for) columns and/or rows in an Excel worksheet.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet in which to resize columns or rows.

fields.name: ResizeMode
fields.label: Resize Mode
fields.description: Specifies what to resize: Columns, Rows, or Both.

fields.name: ResizeType
fields.label: Resize Type
fields.description: Specifies how to resize: AutoFit or Fixed Size.

selectOptions.label: Autofit
selectOptions.description: Automatically adjusts the size based on content.

selectOptions.label: Custom size
selectOptions.description: Sets a custom width or height.

fields.name: StartColumn
fields.label: Start Column
fields.description: The starting column of the range to resize.

fields.name: EndColumn
fields.label: End Column
fields.description: The ending column of the range to resize.

fields.name: StartRow
fields.label: Start Row
fields.description: The starting row of the range to resize.

fields.name: EndRow
fields.label: End Row
fields.description: The ending row of the range to resize.

fields.name: ColumnWidth
fields.label: Column Width
fields.description: The specific column width to set (used when ResizeType is FixedSize).

fields.name: RowHeight
fields.label: Row Height
fields.description: The specific row height to set (used when ResizeType is FixedSize).
